t: This is the Rachel Keeling Nursery School, a school in Tower Hamlets. It takes its name from Rachel Susannah Townsend, a British suffragette. So the name of this nursery connects it to the campaign for women's votes, and every child who attends carries that link in the school's title. I don't have details about her life, or about why the school was named for her, so I'll say no more than that. It's a working nursery, so please keep your distance and respect the children's space.
